prior_outcome.detail: Registration ran the full window and closed at 102. Nothing truncated the curve, so it is genuine demand end to end — a cleaner baseline than a year that hit its cap.

projected_cap.detail: At 2.18x, 2026's curve projects 222 — short of 300. Needs 2.94x. Evidence ends at day 216.
